regions.merged_text: "You are afraid to suffer here & unwilling to go hence; what shall I do with you?" Our Lord to a sick bishop "If I must die once, why not now?" St. Austin "Can one do better than humble that and over- come it which God has given us to master, & which a loving Providence has ordained should be humbled?" i.e. the flesh

regions.merged_text: "The devil" says St. Gregory, "is a lion & a pismire both together; a lion to those who are to him but as pismires; and a pismire to such as behave themselves to him as lion." - i.e. to the courageous in temptations. St. Paulinus of Nola from bishop - to voluntary slave etc. - a rich royal Roman (+431) - Example of Unbounded Charity - having lived in virginity with his holy wife, etc. verichte deine leibliche Liebeswerk für den Nachsten als dientest du Christo Selber; und nehme dasselbe von Anderen an als ein Knecht.

regions.merged_text: "Pray for my Inten. " "Duhasst Recht! ! ! " M. Absent in N.Y. Position in choir. "It is good not to eat flesh and not to drink wine, or anything whereby thy brother is of - fended, or scandalized, or made weak." Roman XIV 21 "My friend, I myself have renounced the world and my inheritance in orter to save my soul; do you think I could advise your son to a contrary course? Why I should think myself deserving of damnation if I did." St. Paul of the Cross to the father of St. Alfons M. de Legouri A.D. 1724
